title: Para Bellum content: rates
description: Cross-system rates and fractions. File: Content/<namespace>/rates.json, exactly ONE across every namespace: the game refuses a second copy and refuses a content set with none. A mod cannot override this file (a recorded limitation). Every figure is a whole number; ratios are per mille. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md in the game repository.

fresh_capture.description: A freshly captured province's reduced output, and how long it lasts.

output_per_mille.description: Output while freshly captured, per mille (500 = half). Note: per MILLE, not per cent.

months.description: How many months the reduction lasts.

capture_damage_per_mille.description: Damage dealt to a province's facilities when it is captured, per mille.

refund_per_mille.description: The share of an order's cost returned when it is cancelled, per pool group, per mille.

line_efficiency.description: A production line's efficiency: where it starts after a design change, and how much it gains per month. The ceiling (1000, whole) is not a balance figure and stays in code.

replacement_cap_strength_per_month.description: The most strength a unit can recover from replacements in one month, in strength points.
